qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: State-granted regulated utility monopoly covering critical Virginia and Carolinas territories. Grid connection to the Northern Virginia data center hub is irreplaceable. However, regulated rate base formulas cap historical ROIC at ~5.0%.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 5 (Management Score = 0, REJECT). Despite an irreplaceable electric utility franchise feeding Northern Virginia data centers, management has a track record of value-destructive capital allocation: billions written off in the canceled Atlantic Coast Pipeline, a 33% dividend cut in 2020, and repeated strategic resets and asset divestitures (Cove Point, gas transmission) to plug balance sheet holes.
qualitative.evidence: Management presided over the disastrous Atlantic Coast Pipeline project, resulting in multi-billion dollar pre-tax charges and project abandonment.
